create_ros_lidar_wrapper: create a RosLidar instance to subscribe to a ROS LaserScan topic and store scan points
get_lidar_points: get the latest 2D Cartesian lidar points as a NumPy array from the RosLidar object
get_lidar_scan_time: get the ROS timestamp of the most recent lidar scan from the RosLidar object
wait_for_lidar_scan: wait for the first lidar scan to arrive before proceeding with robot navigation logic
review_lidar_callback: review the RosLidar _lidar_scan_callback method that converts polar ranges to Cartesian x,y points
